policy_gate: C vs original: rank_delta <= -0.03, top_two_delta > 0, fourth_delta <= 0.01; C vs B: rank_delta < 0, top_two_delta >= 0, fourth_delta <= 0.01
calibration_gate: Select lower held-out permutation NLL from final GRU and fitted score model; must beat fixed score model NLL by >=1%, utility MSE and top-two Brier no worse
acceptance: No live replacement on development; freeze a qualifying candidate before separately budgeting 1000 fresh acceptance groups
